name: PEC-G (Programa de Estudantes-Convênio de Graduação)
host: Government of Brazil (Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Ministry of Education)
amount: Check official page (terms of the PEC-G agreement; living costs are usually your own)
dlText: 9 May 2026 (time not stated) · 2027 selection closed (pre-registration 31 Mar – 9 May 2026)
nextText: Next call (2028 entry) expected ~Mar–May 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle

eligibility.note: Citizens of PEC-G partner countries (mainly Africa, Latin America and Asia) living outside Brazil; no Brazilian or dual Brazilian nationality

fields: Undergraduate courses offered by participating universities
note: Pre-register on the MEC PEC portal and submit through the Brazilian embassy. PEC-G-only applicants need Celpe-Bras; the joint PEC-PLE track lets you learn Portuguese in Brazil first and start your degree a year later.

name: India-Africa Maitri Scholarship Scheme (ICCR)
host: Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), Government of India
amount: Tuition plus monthly stipend and housing allowance (check official page for rates)
dlText: 22 Apr 2026 (time not stated) · 2026-27 round closed (A2A portal open 27 Feb – 22 Apr 2026)
nextText: 2027-28 round expected ~Feb–Apr 2027 on the A2A portal (estimated from 2026 cycle)
nominationBody: Indian Embassy / High Commission in your country
note: About 1,500 slots for African nationals, funded by India's MEA and run by ICCR. Apply on the A2A portal; your application goes through the Indian Mission in your country.

name: Kingdom of Morocco Scholarships for Foreign Students (AMCI)
dlText: Set per partner country; applications go through your government or the Moroccan embassy

eligibility.note: Nationals of AMCI partner countries, mostly African; candidates are usually put forward by their own government

fields: Most fields at Moroccan public institutions
note: Over 12,000 foreign students held Kingdom of Morocco scholarships through AMCI in 2019/20. Some are housed at the Cité Universitaire Internationale in Rabat; ask your ministry or the Moroccan embassy for this year's call.
